tasks.gr8-electrical-systems-and-circuit-safet: Topic: Electrical systems and circuit safety. Cover series and parallel circuits, cells, switches, conductors, fuses, circuit breakers, and earthing. Ask Grade 8 learners to interpret simple circuit diagrams, compare circuit behaviour, and apply safe electrical practices in realistic scenarios.
tasks.gr8-logic-and-pat-design-work-t2: Topic: Logic and PAT design work. Cover AND logic, OR logic, truth tables, control-system thinking, and panic-button design contexts. Ask Grade 8 learners to evaluate input-output conditions, complete truth-table reasoning, and communicate workable PAT design ideas with clear labels.
